commands.sentence: File an issue from quoted text, or render the ledger's status bare: Writes one record under open/; refuses a missing --remedy, a lone word or no checkout.
commands.example: abcd capture "the board drops its last row on an empty ledger" --remedy "render the row before the count"

next.when: before starting work on the issue

commands.sentence: Admit one widening proposal into its run's candidate set: Writes its accepted disposition and an adm-N record; refuses before a committed comparative run.
commands.example: abcd capture admit rdi-2609010000000001 --grounds "the widened configuration is one the next release has to serve"

next.when: to answer the run's other reading items

commands.sentence: Carry an open major or critical issue past one release cut: Writes deferred_after and deferral_reason; refuses a minor or nitpick issue, or an empty reason.
commands.example: abcd capture defer iss-2609010000000001 --after v0.1.0 --reason "the fix needs the parser rewrite that lands next cycle"

next.when: to see the open issues the deferral leaves

commands.sentence: Answer one reading item with a disposition record: Writes the record keyed to the item; refuses a second answer without --supersedes.
commands.usage: abcd capture disposition <rdi-N> --state <accepted|rejected|declined|held> (--grounds <text>, or --exit-condition <text> when held) [--supersedes <dsp-N>] [--recurs <rdi-N,...>] [flags]
commands.example: abcd capture disposition rdi-2609010000000001 --state accepted --grounds "pursued: the tension is real and the next reading will show it again"

next.when: when the item was accepted and should become an intent draft

commands.sentence: Add or remove blocked_by edges on an issue: Writes the issue's blocked_by list; refuses an id the ledger does not hold.

next.when: to see the issue among the others, blocked or not

commands.sentence: List the issues in one status folder or all three: Writes nothing; refuses when no status flag is given.

next.when: to see one issue whole and its next move

commands.sentence: List open issues that default-branch history names with no resolution behind them: Writes nothing; refuses outside a git checkout.

next.when: for an issue a landed change already fixed

commands.sentence: Rewrite retired promote back-links as related_intents and related_issues: Writes the records only with --apply; refuses outside a git checkout.

next.when: after a practice run, to rewrite what it listed

commands.sentence: Graduate an issue or an accepted reading item into an intent draft: Writes the draft and both back-links; refuses a promoted issue or an unaccepted item.

next.when: to plan the draft the promotion filed

commands.sentence: Record a reframe a reading occasioned: Writes one rfm-N fingerprinting the frame before and after; refuses an uncommitted occasion or frame edit without --open.
commands.example: abcd capture reframe --occasioned-by rdi-2609010000000001 --grounds "the reading showed the construal assumed a single operator" --open

next.when: once the reframe has been worked through

commands.sentence: Write or replace the fix an open issue proposes: Writes the issue's remedy; refuses an empty text, the automatic filers' value or an issue that is not open.
commands.example: abcd capture remedy iss-2609010000000001 "make the map before the first write"

commands.sentence: Move an open issue to resolved/, naming what fixed it: Writes the moved record; refuses without --impact or on an id this ledger does not hold.
commands.usage: abcd capture resolve <iss-N> <note> --impact <additive|breaking|fix|internal> [--grounds "<token>: <text>"] [--intent itd-N] [--spec spc-N] [--commit sha] [--shipped-in vX.Y.Z] [flags]
commands.example: abcd capture resolve iss-2609010000000001 "fixed by the parser change" --impact fix

next.when: to push the branch carrying the fix and queue its pull request

commands.sentence: Record one surprise a reading item, admission or disposition occasioned: Writes one srp-N record; refuses an unresolved occasion or a text below the floor.
commands.example: abcd capture surprise --occasioned-by rdi-2609010000000001 "the proposal nobody expected ranked first"

next.when: to see the ledger the surprise sits beside

commands.sentence: Move an open issue to wontfix/ with the reason it is not acted on: Writes the moved record; refuses an id this ledger does not hold.
commands.example: abcd capture wontfix iss-2609010000000001 "the behaviour is the documented one"

next.when: to release the issue's reservation, if one was held
